description: Default permissions. remote.urls is REQUIRED: the webview loads the app-owned sidecar UI from http://127.0.0.1:<port> (a REMOTE origin to Tauri), and capabilities are local-origin-only by default, so without it every IPC command (incl. window start_dragging) is ACL-rejected. Port varies (8787 or fallback) -> wildcard. Loopback + app-owned + token-gated = the app's own trusted UI.
